statistic_convention: Direct teacher/M/F comparison uses head_mean_probability: average raw attention probabilities across heads FIRST, then condition separately over patches within each source. M averages equal source/relation summaries. Separately labelled per_head fields compute spatial statistics per head before averaging and are not directly compared with teacher. Crossband entropy is per_head; M JS uses head-mean joint source-position probabilities.
limits: Teacher averaged-head weights are already returned by existing HDM. New expert weights are independently calculated QK-softmax in non-mutating prehooks with actual FP32 projection parameters, no mask/dropout/bias-kv/causal modification. Original attention forwards are unchanged; all measured output features match saved cache exactly. Conditional spatial entropy separates within-source spatial selection from source selection. Extra M/F query norms, centered within-source key variances before/after actual projection and centered logit standard deviations use FP32; they are not raw CLIP patch variance or identity/foreground truth. No normalization by near-zero variance, no added output path. Entropy/JS are diagnostic, not foreground proof, causal conflict or improved retrieval. Only one fixed mature AQ model, no retraining, missing/49 or multiseed claims.
